description: This is a test class for the SchedulerService component within the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests, setup and cleanup methods, and internal classes to test scheduling functionalities, concurrency, task execution, and database persistence related to scheduler tasks.

classes.name: SchedulerServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the SchedulerService in OpenMRS, including various concurrency and persistence tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, clears scheduled tasks, and sets up logging levels.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Restores logging levels after tests.

methods.name: shouldResolveValidTaskClass
methods.description: Tests if a valid task class can be resolved by the class loader.

methods.name: shouldNotResolveInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests that invalid class resolution throws a ClassNotFoundException.

methods.name: makeRepeatingTaskThatStartsImmediately
methods.description: Creates and registers a repeating task that starts immediately for concurrency testing.

methods.name: shouldAllowTwoTasksToRunConcurrently
methods.description: Tests whether two tasks can run concurrently.

methods.name: shouldAllowTwoTasksInitMethodsToRunConcurrently
methods.description: Tests concurrent execution of init methods.

methods.name: checkTasksRunConcurrently
methods.description: Helper that runs two tasks concurrently and verifies their execution timing.

methods.name: LatchTask
methods.description: Abstract base class for tasks that wait on a latch to test concurrency.

methods.name: LatchInitializeTask
methods.description: Task that waits during initialize phase, used to test concurrent initialization.

methods.name: LatchExecuteTask
methods.description: Task that waits during execution, used to test concurrent execution.

methods.name: InitSequenceTestTask
methods.description: Task to verify that initialization completes before the execute method runs.

methods.name: shouldNotAllowTaskExecuteToRunBeforeInitializationIsComplete
methods.description: Tests that a task's execute method does not run before its initialization completes.

methods.name: saveTask_shouldSaveTaskToTheDatabase
methods.description: Verifies saving a task definition persists correctly.

methods.name: BareTask
methods.description: A simple Task implementation for testing execution without extending AbstractTask.

methods.name: shouldNotThrowExceptionWhenTaskDefinitionIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that tasks implementing Task return successfully even if getTaskDefinition returns null.

methods.name: StoreExecutionTimeTask
methods.description: Task that records its execution time for testing persistence.

methods.name: shouldSaveLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler correctly saves the last execution time of a task.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid_shouldGetTaskByUuid
methods.description: Test retrieval of a task by UUID.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid_shouldReturnNullWhenUuidDoesNotExist
methods.description: Test that retrieving a task by a non-existent UUID returns null.
